case_table_schema.reconstruction: Each case metric_matrix_row selects a row of the decoded metric_matrix. Its next axes use metric_groups and metric_columns. Decode base64, zlib-decompress, verify both hashes, then read C-order little-endian IEEE-754 binary64 with shape [2097,12,7]. The first two metric columns are exact integer sample_count and maximum_error_frame; cast these to int. Other columns retain their exact float64 bits. Reconstruct maximum_absolute_error_volts as abs(signed_error_at_maximum_volts), and maximum_error_time_seconds as maximum_error_frame/sample_rate_hz. All derived values were checked for exact binary64 equality against original rows. Probe metadata uses the indexed dictionary; raw array hash and peak vectors use array_names. No numeric values are rounded. Per-event individual window rows and exact events remain in hash-bound raw JSONL/plan; every complete-case and union/outside metric is retained here.
